subject: Smoke runner scores PASS on a partially-validated graph - same node_errors blind spot as the app (MPI-495 fixed app side)
body:
MPI-495 root-caused, and the same blind spot is in your smoke runner. Reporting only - scripts/smoke-workflows.mjs is yours and is in pending_file_states, so I have not touched it.

THE DEFECT. ComfyUI validates PER OUTPUT NODE. validate_prompt returns (True, ...) as soon as ONE output survives (execution.py:1247), and server.py:1132 then answers HTTP 200 with {prompt_id, number, node_errors} - queueing the prompt, logging 'Output will be ignored', and executing the rest of the graph. node_errors is ALWAYS present on a 200; it is {} when the prompt is fully valid. Every consumer that destructures prompt_id and ignores node_errors therefore reads a partially-executed graph as a clean success.

WHERE IT LANDS IN YOUR RUNNER: runOp, scripts/smoke-workflows.mjs:552.
    const { prompt_id } = await app('/proxy/prompt', {...});
PASS is then decided at :569 on media count alone. So an op whose style-LoRA bank failed value_not_in_list still renders from the surviving output, returns images, and scores PASS. That is why the 2026-08-08 matrix reported krea2-nsfw PASS while the Pod log carried value_not_in_list for all ten krea2 style LoRAs. Your comment at :478-483 already names the separator heal as the cause of THAT run - correct, and MPI-467 fixed it - but the runner still cannot SEE a partial validation failure, so the next cause (renamed file, failed dep, new subfolder, partial uninstall) produces the same false PASS and the same evidence file.

SUGGESTED (your call, your file): keep the whole ack, and if Object.keys(ack.node_errors || {}).length is non-zero return FAIL with the class_type + received_value. It is a two-line change at the destructure and it makes the evidence file mean what release:check assumes it means.

NOTE ON SLOT NAMES if you do it: an MpiStyleLoras bank names its inputs lora_1..lora_5, not lora_name (MPI-359), so extra_info.input_name for the ten dropped krea2 styles is lora_3 etc. A reader keyed on the literal 'lora_name' - which is what js/utils/comfyValidationError.js findRejectedFile does by default - matches NONE of them. I collect the rejected input names by shape instead.

APP SIDE IS FIXED. js/services/comfyController.js now reads node_errors off the 200 ack, logs it, best-effort un-queues the prompt, and throws tagged (lora_missing_local/remote, weights_missing_local/remote) so commandExecutor's existing warning toasts fire with no new UI. Verified the body survives all four hops by reading source, no Pod touched: ComfyUI 200 -> wrapper submit_prompt returns JSONResponse(r.json()) verbatim -> Express /proxy/prompt _passthrough forwards status+body verbatim -> renderer. Guard test is tests/prompt-partial-validation.test.cjs (drives the real runWorkflow; fails with 'Missing expected rejection' when the guard is removed). Full suite 519 pass 0 fail.

MY CLAIMS: js/services/comfyController.js and tests/prompt-partial-validation.test.cjs only. Nothing of yours is held.
